_comment: Credential store for the MT5 bridge. Copy to accounts.json and fill in.
accounts.json is gitignored and must never be committed (spec §47).
Keys are credential_ref values, matching trading_accounts.credential_ref
in Postgres. The database stores the ref; only this file resolves it to a
secret. There is no default account: every request names a ref.
A password can be given inline, or referenced with password_from so a
credential that already exists somewhere is not copied. Paths are Windows
paths as seen by Wine (Z: is the Linux root).
Use an INVESTOR (read-only) password. The bridge reports access as
MASTER_TRADING_ENABLED when the account can trade, so a wrong credential
